feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 4:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 04 June 2026 at 4:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over Scotland will move slowly northwards.


##Wind##

Southwest soon veering west, 5 or 6, but occasionally 7 in east of the area. Slowly decreasing slightly overnight to 4 or 5, occasional 6.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough at first, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Early rain soon followed by showers, some of them heavy, becoming isolated later this evening. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, soon backing southwest, then south 4 or 5, occasional 6 in the west, later in the day. Backing southeast overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain spreading from the south at night and into Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Generally good, occasionally moderate later.
